text: Harden skillcheck.toml handling in src/skillcheck/config_loader.py and the CLI: (1) a wrong-typed value must name the value it got, as in "Config key 'max-lines' must be an integer (got 'nope')", "must be true or false (got 'yes')" and "must be a string (got 5)"; (2) the fallback parser used when tomllib is missing must drop an inline # comment without cutting a # inside a quoted value, through a helper _strip_inline_comment(line) that returns the line without its comment; (3) find_config must stop climbing at a directory that holds .git (a skillcheck.toml there is still found) or at the user's home, never reaching a config above them; (4) the CLI must print "Loaded config from <path>" to stderr when it loads a config file. Add tests.
Wrong-typed values in config must name the value they got (e.g., "Config key 'max-lines' must be an integer (got 'nope')")
Fallback parser must drop inline # comments without cutting # inside quoted values via _strip_inline_comment(line)
find_config must stop climbing at a directory holding .git or at the user's home
CLI must print "Loaded config from <path>" to stderr when it loads a config file
